author: Aman Yadav
review_text: I had a good experience using eSewa. The app is easy to use, and transactions are fast and secure. It is very useful for mobile recharge, bill payments, and sending money. The interface is simple and convenient. Overall, I am satisfied with eSewa and would recommend it to others.
